title: Fix AITDK batch timeout aborts, reduce batch to 5, and enable single-domain fallback on abort to prevent queue head lock
summary: 1) In search(), when a batch times out/aborts (isAbort), run quick single-domain fallback with 4s timeout (SINGLE_TIMEOUT_MS) so healthy domains have traffic saved and hanging domains are isolated and marked queriedDomains, preventing identical batches from repeating indefinitely in an endless loop; 2) Reduce BATCH_SIZE to 5 domains so AITDK responds in 1.5-2.5s; 3) Set DIRECT_TIMEOUT_MS to 15s so stuck batches fail fast instead of hanging 30s; 4) Suppress repetitive 'gọi trực tiếp lỗi' console logging during single-domain fallback.
